lanes.summary: The diff successfully implements ticket PMAT-3500 without violating any constraints. `pv extract` correctly extracts deterministic N-Triples (`contracts/contracts.nt`) and `contracts/shapes.ttl`. The SHACL-Core subset is parsed accurately according to §3.6, with unsupported components raising an error. The `shapes` gate correctly plants a positive control `pc_shape` and asserts that `plant_violations >= 1` in order to pass, thereby guaranteeing that shapes are actively evaluated. The first shape effectively targets `ont:Contract` because its `entity.type` is `pv-contract`, mapping to the default target class. No tests weaken gates or assert opposites of the ticket.

The diff correctly implements the requested functionality according to PMAT-3500 and the refutation doctrine. `ontology/shapes.rs` correctly defines `ShapeError::Unsupported` and explicitly refuses unrecognized keys in the shape object mapping rather than silently bypassing them. `pv extract` emits N-Triples where IRIs are correctly percent-encoded via `percent_encode` within `rdf.rs`. The positive control plant asserts exactly 1 violation via tests matching the actual corpus validation output. Furthermore, `ont:file` avoids an unnecessary `maxCount` constraint in `ont-shapes-v1.yaml`, preventing reporting overlaps with the existing duplicate-stems gate. Verdict is PASS.
